title: Don't Secure the Code. Secure the Coder.
description:
AI agents don't just write insecure code. They can escape their sandboxes and delete files, posing significant security threats. The traditional security model that worked in the cloud era is no longer sufficient. It fails to address the unique challenges that agentic development presents, leaving systems vulnerable to new types of attacks.

Guy Podjarny, the founder of Snyk and CEO of Tessl, delivered a compelling keynote at London's AI Security Summit. He argues it's time to shift our focus from securing the code to securing the coder. His expertise at the intersection of AI and security provides vital insights into why agentic development requires a transformed approach to safeguarding our digital environments.

What we cover:
• Why is shadow AI considered the new shadow IT, and why can't CISOs secure what they can't see?
• Skills have become a new supply chain attack surface with risks like malicious and negligent skills.
• The OWASP Top Ten for Agentic AI presents challenges for development teams today.
• Why does security need to become agentic to counter attackers who already are?
• How leading organizations are implementing the Context Development Lifecycle (CDLC).
